allow_instructions: Allow narrow read-only repository state queries such as git status, branch, rev-parse, remote -v, and ls-files.
Allow running ./tools/check-agent-safety, ./tools/validate-safe, or ./tools/check-sensitive-metadata only after their contents have been reviewed.
block_instructions: Block privilege escalation including sudo, su, and doas.
Block shell-wrapper bypasses such as bash -c, sh -c, env, xargs, find -exec, make, and python -c used to run other commands.
Block Git write and history operations including commit, push, tag, reset, rebase, clean, merge, checkout, switch, cherry-pick, revert, amend, and config changes.

Require manual review for git diff, git grep, git show, git log, and any Git invocation using --no-index, --ext-diff, or --textconv, including commands that can read ignored, untracked, or out-of-workspace files.
Block live Terraform and OCI operations including plan with credentials, apply, destroy, import, state changes, and force-unlock.
Block Ansible execution against any inventory, including ansible-playbook, ansible-pull, and ansible-galaxy.
Block Kubernetes and Helm operations including kubectl, helm, kustomize, and argocd mutations or secret reads.
Block MicroK8s lifecycle commands and host cluster installation or teardown.
Block reading real secrets, credentials, private keys, Terraform state, tfvars, kubeconfigs, or Ansible Vault material.
Block package, service, network, DNS, firewall, routing, storage, mount, and filesystem formatting mutations.
Block executing Version-1 bootstrap scripts under scripts/.
Block modifying Safety files under .cursor/, .cursorignore, AGENTS.md, or tools/check-agent-safety and tools/validate-safe and then immediately executing the changed wrappers.
